# Buho Jump

Canonical site: https://home.mybuho.de/jump/
Repository: https://github.com/Buho-Ecosystem/Buho-Jump
License: AGPL-3.0-only

Buho Jump is an open-source browser extension for Nostr identity, encrypted messaging, and Bitcoin Lightning payments. It includes NIP-07 signing, NIP-46 remote signing, WebLN support, NWC wallet connectivity, Cashu wallet support, multi-account handling, and per-site permissions.

## Best entry points

- `/README.md` - product overview, install steps, feature summary, tech stack
- `/PRIVACY_POLICY.md` - storage, transmission, and privacy model
- `/FAQ.md` - short answers for users and search/discovery systems
- `/blog/01-nip46-remote-signing.md` - remote signer architecture and UX
- `/blog/02-why-another-nostr-extension.md` - product positioning and differentiators
- `/blog/03-your-keys-your-rules.md` - key storage and encryption model
- `/blog/04-lightning-in-your-browser.md` - WebLN and Lightning flow
- `/blog/05-private-messaging.md` - encrypted messaging model
- `/blog/06-from-nos2x-to-buho.md` - migration guide
- `/blog/07-built-different.md` - technical architecture
